title: TRICARE Retired Reserve Retired Reserve Closing Reconciliation: Spreading a Settled Change Over Counted Days
content:
**Rule (TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Retired Reserve).** Which counted days of the monthly bill that change applies to follows the period it covers: where the change credit or paid adjustment covers only part of the month, it is spread over the days it covers and applies to the counted days from the first day it covers; where it covers the whole month, it is spread over every day of the month and applies to every counted day; otherwise it applies to no counted day.

**Terms.** A change is spread by dividing it by the days it is spread over, and applies at that daily figure for each counted day it reaches. A change covering part of a month runs from the DEERS event date to the month's last day. Counted days run from the bill's first counted day through the month's last day.

**Hypothetical (May, 31 days).** A change credit of 387.33 covering 18 to 31 May (14 days), counted days 20 to 31 May: 27.6664 a day for 12 days, 331.9971. Had the change covered the whole of May, it would be spread over 31 days and applied to all 12 counted days.
